title: Autograph Please
desc: A man contracts HIV because of an affair with a bar girl prior to his wedding. However, he decides to live normally and encourages other HIV patients to brave the ordeal.

title: Nunakuzhi
desc: A wealthy entrepreneur's flawless facade crumbles when his company faces a high-profile IT raid, revealing a complex network of tax evasion and illicit dealings that threaten to destroy his empire.

title: Boss
desc: Ram and Raj are estranged twins. When Raj learns that Ram has been mysteriously murdered, he sets out to avenge his death.

title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.

title: Kurubana Rani
desc: Kencha and Rani mutually agree to take part in a staged wedding ceremony. However, things take an unexpected turn after Kencha falls in love with Rani.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Navathare
desc: Partha wants to play cricket but his father strives to stop him at every step. Eventually, when he is thrown out of the cricket academy due to his father's influence, he starts using drugs.

title: Gandugali Kumara Rama
desc: Kumararama, son of King Deva Raya, is exiled by his stepmother. However, he strives to overcome the challenges that life throws at him.
